targets.text: Colleague's cortex delegates BY PURPOSE: web_survey / code_survey (and review) are typed loop tools that run a scout (or reviewer) child on a FIXED seat — the associate when armed — and return a digest with evidence ids; cortex no longer holds the raw web tool (replace, not add); on the associate side effort is split per seat (scout off, distill low), the multi-turn scout keeps its thinking history, and measurement arms run in a memory-armed repo — the same enumerated seats addressed by purpose instead of by mechanism, never a per-turn model choice

On the armed rig (COLLEAGUE_ASSOCIATE_MODEL=lobes, webglass on PATH) the offered tool list of a bare 'colleague work' contains web_survey/code_survey/review/validate/plan and NOT web; a code_survey step's child artifact records the associate's served model; with the knobs unset (no associate, COLLEAGUE_WEB=0 / no webglass, no ASSOCIATE_SEAT_TABLE overrides) the byte-identical suite vs main @ e589451 passes unchanged

Purpose tools land exactly like the deepthink tool: a schema OUTSIDE tools.SCHEMAS appended by curate_schemas (tools.py:533-626 DEEPTHINK_SCHEMA / line 625) with an INJECTED executor callable (tools.py:1236-1261 _deepthink_tool degrades to a plain string when nothing is injected); web_survey is hidden whenever web is hidden (web_schemas.offered/hidden_names, web_schemas.py:96-108 — COLLEAGUE_WEB=0 or no webglass on PATH), code_survey is always offered; both live in a NEW module (purpose_schemas.py, the search_schemas/web_schemas shape) — tools.py (1508), loop.py (5281), vllm_openai.py (1324), subagents.py (1692) are pinned by tests/test_file_length_ratchet.py so the hunks there are net-zero

tools.SCHEMAS is unchanged (no purpose schema inside it); curate_schemas(role) appends the purpose schemas only for roles whose allow-list names them; web_survey disappears together with web under COLLEAGUE_WEB=0 / no webglass; a purpose call with nothing injected returns the plain 'not configured' string, never raises; tests/file_length_baseline.json entries for tools.py/loop.py/vllm_openai.py/subagents.py are unchanged

Each purpose tool runs the EXISTING spawn path with a fixed role: the injected callable is the loop's subagent_spawn (subagents.make_spawn → run_subagent, subagents.py:822-856) called with role='scout' (web_survey/code_survey) or role='reviewer' (review) and a fixed brief template ('find X, cite operation_id/evidence_refs'); associate_seats.scout_child_config (associate_seats.py:191-229) already swaps a scout child onto the associate seat when armed — ASSOCIATE_SEATS stays the five-tuple (test_associate_seats.py:57) and no new seat builder exists: fixed purpose → fixed role → fixed seat

the purpose executor calls the loop's existing subagent_spawn with role fixed per tool (scout/reviewer/validator/planner) and a fixed brief; associate_seats.ASSOCIATE_SEATS is still the five-tuple and scout_child_config is untouched (git diff main -- colleague/associate_seats.py has only the effort-table hunk); the child's SubResult lands on sub_results exactly like a manual subagent

REPLACE, not add (revisits web-scout spec decision q3, recorded here): the raw web tool leaves the top-level acting surface — web stays in roles._READONLY_TOOLS/_SCOUT_TOOLS (roles.py:88-105) for children, but curate_schemas withholds it from the writer role / thinker_coder purpose (agents/tools.py THINKER_CODER_TOOLS = every registry tool, line ~160) so cortex holds web_survey and never web; a failed fetch then comes back as a digest saying 'unreachable' — the row-47 re-run evidence (#443 comment: cortex with web + run_command drifted into host recon, /etc/hosts, ss -ltnp, ~/.cloudflared; stopped by pilot, d15)

curate_schemas('writer') and the thinker_coder purpose surface no longer contain 'web' while curate_schemas('scout'/'explorer'/'reviewer'/...) still do; the web-scout frame decision q3 is superseded by a recorded decision in this spec; the run report's web line appears on the CHILD artifact and is summarised on the parent's tool result

Tool classification: agents/tools.py classifies subagent/subagents as class 'write' (_WRITE_CLASS line 80) and non-inheritable (_NOT_INHERITABLE line 88); tae_loop.CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS (tae_loop.py:106-112) lists subagent/subagents — a purpose tool spawns a PROVABLY read-only child (roles.is_read_only, roles.py:243-256; scout/reviewer tool_allowlist ⊂ read-only set), so it needs its own ToolProfile row and an explicit CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS decision (widening that tuple is 'a deliberate, visible edit', tae_loop.py:104)

TOOL_PROFILES[purpose] == ToolProfile(class='read', required_approval=False, inheritable=True) for all five; tae_loop.CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS is unchanged (5 entries); the purpose child's role is a read-only builtin so roles.is_read_only(role) is True for every purpose tool's role

Armed agents mode (#411) refuses a child whose requested_tools are not ⊆ the parent's effective tools (agents/delegation.py:164-179) and the web-scout spec pinned 'a scout child receives web only when the parent's surface contains it' (spec honesty line 33) — replace-don't-add on cortex CONTRADICTS that ⊆ pin: a purpose tool's child surface is FIXED BY THE TOOL (the role allow-list), not requested by the parent, so the ⊆ rule must be stated over the parent's surface PLUS the purpose tool's fixed child set — a recorded change to that honesty condition, never a silent one

agents/delegation.validate treats a purpose-tool delegation's requested_tools as the role allow-list (fixed) and does NOT refuse it when the parent lacks web; the old honesty condition (web-scout spec line 33) is marked superseded in docs/features/web-scout.md and its pinning test is rewritten, not deleted

scripts/compare_arms.py counts delegations as subagent/subagents steps (compare_arms.py:181-183) and associate_calls by matching a delegation step's recorded served_model to artifact['associate']['served_model'] (191-215): the purpose-tool call rate joins the delegations column and a purpose step records served_model like a subagent step; the same 1.0× turns / 1.2× wall bar as row 48; a miss is a miss

compare_arms.py's delegations column counts steps whose tool is subagent/subagents OR any of the five purpose tools; associate_calls counts a purpose step whose served_model equals the artifact's associate served_model; a purpose step records served_model in Step.arguments like a subagent step

Per-seat effort on the associate side: effort.SEAT_TABLE has ONE 'associate': 'off' row (effort.py:69) and every associate seat resolves seat='associate' (associate.py:86-94 associate_engine_config; associate_seats.py:220-227 scout_child_config); env overrides are generated from SEAT_TABLE keys as COLLEAGUE_<SEAT>_REASONING_EFFORT (effort.py:246-256) and config.json reasoning_effort_seats keys are seat names (config.py:2021-2025). Split shape: an ASSOCIATE_SEAT_TABLE {scout: off, compact: off, synthesis: off, digest: off, distill: low} consulted between the associate row and the per-seat override, with COLLEAGUE_ASSOCIATE_REASONING_EFFORT_<SEAT> overrides; the 'default' kill-switch still wins; unset = byte-identical for every seat but distill

effort.ASSOCIATE_SEAT_TABLE == {scout: off, compact: off, synthesis: off, digest: off, distill: low}; precedence for an associate seat: kill-switch > parent_override > COLLEAGUE_ASSOCIATE_REASONING_EFFORT_<SEAT> / reasoning_effort_seats['associate.<seat>'] > COLLEAGUE_ASSOCIATE_REASONING_EFFORT (the associate row override) > ASSOCIATE_SEAT_TABLE; with nothing set scout/compact/synthesis/digest resolve exactly as today ('off')

The distill child sends NO effort today: _openai_completion (distill.py:613-647) POSTs only model/messages/max_tokens/temperature over raw urllib, the child argv is --repo/--task-id/--model (distill.py:753-755) with base_url/key via env, and associate_seats.distill_author returns DistillAuthor(model, base_url, api_key) with no rung (associate_seats.py:231-245). 'distill low' therefore needs (a) an effort value threaded to the detached child (argv/env) and (b) a chat_template_kwargs fragment on that second raw OpenAI POST site with the ladder-400 retry-once rule mirrored (vllm_openai.py:1099-1105 pops the whole fragment) — a plumbing task, not a table row

the detached distill child receives its rung (argv --effort or env) and _openai_completion sends chat_template_kwargs {reasoning_effort: low} (or enable_thinking false for off / nothing for default); a ladder-400 on that POST retries ONCE without the fragment and writes the warning into the child's outcome marker; the child's completion record keeps reasoning chars

Memory arming in measurement repos: the loop arms memory only when <memory-repo>/.eidetic is a directory (loop.py:2505-2514 _memory_armed) and the eidetic CLI is installed (config.py:2124-2140, default-on); the distill seat fires only via _resolve_distill_fn when ctx.distill_author and memory_distill are set (loop.py:2606-2625). Every pre-registered arm row (rows 49+) states 'repo WITH an .eidetic store' explicitly and records the artifact's memory distill counters (distill: detached alive-counters) — row 45's zero-associate-calls arm measured 'arming is inert here' for exactly this reason (docs/live-testing.md:109)

docs/live-testing.md rows 49 and 50 are written BEFORE any run and each names 'repo WITH an .eidetic store' and the eidetic CLI version; each row records the artifact's memory distill counters (attempts/validated/detached) and the distill child's served model

Delegation prose follows the tools: delegation_text.apply_armed_facts splices the armed-seat sentence onto subagent/subagents descriptions only (delegation_text.py:26,50-60) and the opt-in HANDOVER_EXAMPLE section (prompttext.py:175-227, COLLEAGUE_PROMPT_SECTIONS) names subagent; purpose tools get the armed-facts sentence on web_survey/code_survey and a one-line description each — no new prompt section (the #437/#440 lesson: prompt text buys deliberation, arms measured v1 prompt ≈ parity)

delegation_text.apply_armed_facts splices the armed sentence onto web_survey/code_survey (and still subagent/subagents); no new prompttext SECTION_TABLE entry is added; the default system prompt text is byte-identical to v1.65.1

Live rows 49/50 pre-registered BEFORE any run: (49) the row-48 decomposable brief (docs/live-testing/briefs/row48-delegation.md) n=3 with code_survey offered vs main @ e589451, bar turns ≤ 1.0× / wall ≤ 1.2×, delegations column = purpose-tool calls, ≥ 1 on ≥ 2 of 3 runs; (50) the row-47 web brief with web_survey (cortex holds NO web): the scout child's served model = the associate's, evidence ids cited in the answer, and ZERO steps outside the brief's repo (no run_command host probing — the d15 drift cannot recur because the seat holding web has no run_command)

row 49 (n=3 with code_survey vs main @ e589451 re-run n=3): purpose-tool calls ≥ 1 on ≥ 2 of 3 runs AND turns ≤ 1.0× AND wall ≤ 1.2× (compare_arms.py, never prose); row 50 (web brief with web_survey): scout child served model = associate's, evidence ids in the final answer, and zero run_command steps outside the repo; a miss is written as a miss

Never a router (CLAUDE.md:293-360, eleven sanctioned increments): a purpose tool is the deepthink precedent (increment 1 — one tool, one judgment, one declared seat) addressed by purpose; the model calls it explicitly and the runtime never picks a model per turn — pinned today by tests/test_thinking_effort_boundary.py:150 (no per-turn path assigns effort) and tests/test_associate_seats.py:90 (AST guard: .associate referenced only by the enumerated consumers); both guards must still pass with the new modules added to their sanctioned lists

CLAUDE.md's increment count stays eleven; the Web scout bullet + increment (1) text name purpose tools as the deepthink precedent applied by purpose; tests/test_thinking_effort_boundary.py and tests/test_associate_seats.py's AST guards pass with purpose_schemas.py/templatekwargs.py added to their sanctioned lists with a stated reason; no per-turn path selects a model

The associate seat builders are untouched except for the rung: ASSOCIATE_SEATS stays ('scout','compact','synthesis','digest','distill'); code-authoring seats never reference config.associate (test_associate_seats.py:90-108); 'review' runs the existing reviewer role (roles.py:168-177, ROLE_TABLE reviewer=low) on CORTEX — reviewer is NOT an associate seat and adding it would be a spec change to the five-tuple

git diff main -- colleague/associate_seats.py colleague/associate.py touches only effort resolution (the sub-seat rung), ASSOCIATE_SEATS is unchanged, and review/validate/plan children never reference config.associate

The effort tables are pinned exactly: tests/test_effort.py:20-58 pins every SEAT_TABLE/ROLE_TABLE row and the exact key sets, and tests/test_thinking_effort_docs.py:55-72 requires docs/features/thinking-effort.md to render every table row (and forbids a duplicate table elsewhere, line 74) — a new associate sub-seat table lands with its pin rows and its doc table in the SAME PR; /effort, config show and the max_tokens line iterate SEAT_TABLE (_session_actions.py:89-104, config.py:82, harness_cli.py:34) and must list the sub-seat rows or say they are folded

tests/test_effort.py pins every ASSOCIATE_SEAT_TABLE row and the exact key set; docs/features/thinking-effort.md renders each row exactly once; /effort, config show and the max_tokens line list associate.scout/compact/synthesis/digest/distill (or state they fold into the associate row) — decided in the plan, recorded in the doc

Doc drift to fix in the doc pass: docs/features/adopt-from-qwen-code.md:176-177 says ROLE_TABLE['scout'] = 'low' while effort.py:79 declares 'off' (and test_effort pins the key but not the value) — the feature doc must state 'off' with the t19 reason
docs/features/adopt-from-qwen-code.md states ROLE_TABLE['scout'] = 'off' with the t19 reason; no doc claims 'low' for the unarmed scout

The operator running cortex (Qwen3.8-27B, main @ e589451) with COLLEAGUE_ASSOCIATE_MODEL=lobes (Nemotron 3.5 Lightning on Orin, addressed on the wire as the role name 'associate') and webglass on PATH, who saw 0 delegations in 13 measured runs (rows 41-48) but 8 web calls in one turn (row 47) and wants the fetch loop and the survey loop to run on the fast seat by calling ONE typed tool — never by writing a subagent brief
the feature doc names the audience by ROLE (cortex / associate / scout / reviewer / validator / planner), never by model id in config code; the zero-model-ids boundary test passes

Before: cortex holds web (shared surface, web-scout q3) AND run_command; delegation is never chosen (0 subagent calls in 13 runs, rows 41-48) while typed tools are (8 web calls turn 1, row 47; unprompted grep_search/glob, row 48); the associate seat idles (row 45 zero associate calls); the distill child completes with no effort rung at all (distill.py:613-647); one associate-wide 'off' row covers scout and distill alike (effort.py:69)

the spec's before-state quotes rows 41-48 (0 delegations / 13 runs), row 47 (8 web calls turn 1; host recon d15), row 45 (zero associate calls) and distill.py:613-647 (no effort key) verbatim from docs/live-testing.md and the code — not restated from memory

Why: the shape of the ask decides delegation — subagent demands a meta-decision (brief, role, isolation), a typed tool is one call; row 48 showed adding surface buys deliberation (3.31× wall / 1.41× turns, 2× reasoning chars, 0/3 delegations) and row 47 re-run showed cortex holding web+run_command drifts into host reconnaissance; the direct seat numbers (scout 17 s off vs 25 s low; digest 9 s off vs 61 s low with a better judgment half) say scout=off / distill=low is the right split — docs/live-testing.md rows 45/47/48
the feature doc cites the direct-seat numbers (17 s/25 s survey, 9 s/61 s digest) with their date and row 45, and the row-48 numbers (3.31×/1.41×, 2× reasoning chars) with artifact ids

After: on the armed rig 'colleague work' offers web_survey/code_survey (no raw web on cortex); cortex calls code_survey('interfaces of alpha/beta/gamma') and gets a digest from a scout child whose artifact records the associate's served model; web_survey('find X', urls=[...]) returns a digest with operation_id/evidence_refs or an honest 'unreachable' line; a memory-armed run's distill child completes at low with reasoning chars on its record; the multi-turn scout's earlier thinking is kept in its own history; COLLEAGUE_WEB=0 / no webglass hides web_survey, an unarmed rig runs the same tools on cortex, and the unset-knob suite is byte-identical to v1.65.1

the row-49 artifact shows web_survey/code_survey/review/validate/plan in the offered list, no 'web', a code_survey step with a child artifact whose served model is the associate's; the row-50 artifact shows a web_survey digest with operation_id/evidence_refs or an 'unreachable' digest line; a memory-armed run's distill marker shows reasoning chars at low; COLLEAGUE_WEB=0 hides web_survey only; the unset suite is byte-identical to v1.65.1

Five purpose tools, each fixed purpose → fixed built-in role → fixed seat: web_survey and code_survey → scout (associate when armed), review → reviewer, validate → validator (read-only + run_tests, roles.py:102), plan → planner — all read-only builtins (roles.py:147-197, is_read_only True); reviewer/validator/planner run on cortex at their ROLE_TABLE rungs (low/low/medium, effort.py:73-80) because only scout is an ASSOCIATE_SEATS member; no writer purpose tool exists

PURPOSE_ROLE table == {web_survey: scout, code_survey: scout, review: reviewer, validate: validator, plan: planner}; every value is a read-only builtin; each child's rung comes from effort.PURPOSE_TABLE (web_survey/code_survey/review/validate/plan each their own row) passed as the spawn's explicit effort override — NOT the role's ROLE_TABLE rung; the three cortex roles run on the parent's cortex config, scout on the associate seat only when armed; the kill-switch still yields no fragment

each purpose child resolves its rung from its OWN role row — review=low, validate=low, plan=medium, code_survey/web_survey=off (scout; on the associate seat when armed) — and NEVER from the parent's cortex rung, the parent's seat override, or the global rung; deepthink stays xhigh and tools-off (unchanged); asserted on the child config's reasoning_effort_seat for every purpose under a parent at medium

Purpose-tool class (q2): every READ-ONLY purpose tool is ToolProfile class 'read', NOT in tae_loop.CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS and NOT inheritable (q9: children never hold purpose tools; they are offered to cortex + worker only); the child role's tool_allowlist is a read-only builtin so the spawn cannot mutate the tree (roles.is_read_only); the plan purpose returns a plan ARTIFACT as text, never a file write. handover_to_colleague is class 'write', consequential, non-inheritable — exactly subagent's profile, which it replaces

no purpose tool is in CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS or _NOT_INHERITABLE; a TAE run treats a purpose call as a non-consequential action; the plan tool's ToolOutcome.result is text (the child's finish) and the child's changed-file set is empty by construction (read-only role)

Purpose child surface exemption (q3): agents/delegation.py's requested_tools ⊆ parent check treats a purpose tool's child surface as FIXED BY THE TOOL — the child's effective tools = the role allow-list ∩ the environment (webglass presence for web), independent of the parent's curated surface; the web-scout spec's honesty condition (docs/specs/2026-08-28-web-scout-associate.md:33) is superseded and its pinning test rewritten to the new rule

agents/delegation.validate accepts a purpose delegation whose requested_tools (the role allow-list ∩ environment) exceed the parent's curated surface ONLY for purpose tools; a manual subagent/subagents delegation is still refused on a superset; the web-scout spec honesty line 33 is marked superseded in docs/features/web-scout.md

Scope-line placement (q5): CLAUDE.md records purpose tools under sanctioned increment (1) — the deepthink precedent — in the Web scout bullet + the increment (1) text; the count stays eleven; the excluded router line is unchanged
CLAUDE.md § v1 scope: increment (1) text gains one clause naming purpose tools; the eleven count and the excluded-router sentence are unchanged; docs/features/purpose-tools.md is the pointer

Worktree (q1): every purpose child runs via the unchanged run_subagent path in a sub/<id> worktree (subagents.py:830,1298-1314); the cost is one worktree_add per call under worktrees.py's fcntl lock — recorded on the tool's report line; no new execution path

a purpose child runs through run_subagent unchanged (worktree_add on sub/<id>, teardown on every exit path); the parent's tool result line names the child id and its worktree cost is visible on WorkStats (subagent count); no code path in purpose_schemas.py touches worktrees

Purpose tools carry NO 'effort' parameter — the model cannot pick a rung; the rung is c29's PURPOSE_TABLE row passed as the spawn's explicit override. HONEST LIMIT recorded, not fixed here (c29 keeps the manual path byte-identical): a MANUAL subagent/subagents child still resolves seat_override from the parent's seat override (subagents.py:700-722, 896-916), which resolve_effort ranks above the child's ROLE_TABLE row (effort.py:130-132) — so COLLEAGUE_CORTEX_REASONING_EFFORT=medium leaks into a manual reviewer child; docs/features/thinking-effort.md § Honest limits names it; follow-up parked as v5

the five purpose schemas have no 'effort' property (schema test); under COLLEAGUE_CORTEX_REASONING_EFFORT=medium a review purpose child's payload carries reasoning_effort=low while a MANUAL subagent role='reviewer' child carries medium — both asserted side by side, and the feature doc's Honest limits names the manual-path leak with that test as its pointer

challenge / failure-mode lens: the web budget is PER EXECUTOR — 'each subagent child, which builds its own executor, carries its own independent counter, never the parent's' (webbudget.py:9-10) — so N web_survey calls × COLLEAGUE_WEB_MAX_CALLS(20) is unbounded per work item; the purpose child must draw from ONE work-item-wide web budget: the parent passes its remaining count into the child spec and folds the child's web_calls/web_failed back into its own counters + WorkStats on return (the resume_counts precedent, webbudget.py:118)

with COLLEAGUE_WEB_MAX_CALLS=5, three web_survey calls whose scouts fetch 2 pages each end with the third scout refused at call 6 (cap message on the child's result AND on the parent's tool result); result.stats.web_calls on the PARENT artifact == 5

challenge / failure-mode lens: a purpose child is a full bounded loop; ChildSpec.max_steps already exists (subagents.py:105,682,884) — each READ-ONLY purpose carries a FIXED max_steps in its table row (proposal: web_survey 12, code_survey 12, review 16, validate 16, plan 10, operator-overridable), and a child that exhausts it returns its partial/forced synthesis as the tool result prefixed '[purpose budget exhausted: N steps]' — never an empty string, never a raise (the #191/#192 precedent). Per decision c39 the read-only purposes are EXEMPT from MAX_SUBAGENT_FANOUT/TOTAL (only cortex/worker can call them, so no recursion; the parent's own COLLEAGUE_MAX_STEPS bounds the call count, one step per call); handover_to_colleague (writer) still charges depth/total

a purpose child hitting its step cap yields a non-empty tool result carrying the '[purpose budget exhausted' marker and the child's INCOMPLETE status on sub_results; the 25th purpose call in one work item returns the agent-budget refusal as a string (no exception on the parent's step trace)

challenge / security lens: the D2 read-then-fetch channel now crosses the purpose boundary — cortex (which can read_file secrets) supplies web_survey's urls[]/question, the scout fetches; the run report must show it at the PARENT: the parent's tool result and its run-report web line list every URL the child fetched (from the child's Step.result envelopes, verbatim), and a pre_tool hook deny on web still fires inside the child (the child loop loads the repo hooks: loop.py:4834 load_hooks(task.repo_path)) — no new policy, the operator's three D2 mitigations keep working through the boundary

a web_survey call whose scout fetched two URLs leaves both URLs on the parent's Step.result and on the parent artifact's web report line; a .colleague/hooks.json pre_tool deny on 'web' makes the child's web calls fail and the digest says so — e2e mock test with a fake webglass

challenge / hidden-dependency lens: three effort key shapes now coexist — seat (COLLEAGUE_<SEAT>_REASONING_EFFORT / reasoning_effort_seats), associate sub-seat (COLLEAGUE_ASSOCIATE_REASONING_EFFORT_<SEAT> / reasoning_effort_seats['associate.<seat>'], c8) and purpose (COLLEAGUE_<PURPOSE>_REASONING_EFFORT / reasoning_effort_purposes, c29); every value passes validate_effort (effort.py:99-116), config show / /effort render all three groups, and a purpose-called scout's rung is the PURPOSE row (explicit override) — ASSOCIATE_SEAT_TABLE.scout applies ONLY to a manual subagent role='scout'; both tables spell scout=off and a test pins that they agree

config show on an armed config prints seat, associate.<seat> and purpose rung groups; an invalid value in any of the three refuses at resolve() with the validate_effort message; test asserts PURPOSE_TABLE['code_survey'] == ASSOCIATE_SEAT_TABLE['scout'] == 'off'

challenge / failure-mode lens: the distill child POSTs max_tokens=_DISTILL_MAX_TOKENS=4096 (distill.py:577,626) and vLLM counts reasoning tokens inside max_tokens; at 'low' the associate produced 17k reasoning chars (~4k+ tokens, #439) before the judgment — so the lesson JSON would be cut with finish_reason='length' and rung-2 silently yields no lesson; the child's max_tokens rises when a rung is ON (proposal: 4096 → 12288 at low/medium/high, unchanged at off/default) and finish_reason='length' is recorded as its own failure reason in the outcome marker ('reasoning exhausted max_tokens'), never folded into 'no lesson extracted'
a fake server returning finish_reason='length' with reasoning and no JSON leaves an outcome marker naming 'length'; the POST body at low carries max_tokens ≥ 12288 and at off carries 4096 (unchanged)

handover_to_colleague(task, optional acceptance[]) — the sixth purpose tool and the WRITE purpose: runs a writer-role child on the parent's cortex config (same model, the qwen-direct 'spawns ITSELF' rule) in a sub/<id> worktree with the existing merge-on-return (subagents.run_subagent unchanged), rung = ROLE_TABLE writer (medium) via PURPOSE_TABLE, max_steps = the parent's default; it REPLACES raw subagent on cortex/worker (with q10 dropping subagents, neither raw delegation tool is offered there); a writer child still counts against MAX_SUBAGENT_DEPTH/TOTAL (it can mutate and merge) — the read-only purposes do not; the child's changed files fold into the parent's set exactly as a subagent's do

curate_schemas('writer') on cortex offers handover_to_colleague and the five read-only purposes and NEITHER subagent NOR subagents; a handover child's SubResult carries changed_files that reach the parent's handoff; a handover child hitting MAX_SUBAGENT_DEPTH returns the refusal text; test_e2e_mock shows mock and vllm-openai yield the same sub_results shape
